title: e-Newsletter Archive | Congressman Tim Walberg
text:
e-Newsletter Archive
March 8, 2026
As you know, much of our district was battered by severe storms and tornadoes on March 6, some of which have tragically taken the lives of members of our community.
February 28, 2026
On Tuesday, President Trump addressed our nation at the State of the Union.
February 21, 2026
There are countless stories from across the country of innocent Americans having property unjustly seized due to abuses within the civil asset forfeiture process.
February 14, 2026
On Wednesday, House Republicans stood with the overwhelming majority of Americans who demand secure elections.
February 7, 2026
My office is seeking submissions from high school students in the 5th Congressional District for the 2026 Congressional Art Competition.
January 29, 2026
Thanks to Republican leadership, this year will be the largest tax refund season in American history, with Americans estimated to receive $91 billion in additional tax refunds.
January 24, 2026
On Monday, I had the privilege of recognizing Jim Gillis of Niles as Veteran of the Month for January.
January 17, 2026
On Wednesday, I was invited to the White House to witness President Trump sign the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act into law.
January 10, 2026
On Thursday, my bill, the Enhancing Detection of Human Trafficking Act, was advanced by the Education and Workforce Committee.
December 29, 2025
2025 has been one of the most productive years in Congress in recent memory.
summary: As you know, much of our district was battered by severe storms and tornadoes on March 6, some of which have tragically taken the lives of members of our community. There are countless stories from across the country of innocent Americans having property unjustly seized due to abuses within the civil asset forfeiture process. On Wednesday, House Republicans stood with the overwhelming majority of Americans who demand secure elections. On Wednesday, I was invited to the White House to witness President Trump sign the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act into law.
